title: A line copied in the sim or vis dialog is lost from the clipboard when the dialog closes
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG11.8.21 (reported 2026-10-14, Windows and macOS, the vis dialog from exudyn dialog vis and from the V key): copy line and copy all used tkinter's clipboard, which Tk serves only while its window exists; in a process that goes on after the dialog closes, the clipboard is empty (reproduced on Windows; update() after clipboard_append does not help). The text has to be given to the system clipboard: Win32 on Windows, pbcopy on macOS, wl-copy/xclip/xsel on Linux, tkinter as fallback.
releaseNotes: copy line and copy all of the sim and vis dialogs give the text to the system clipboard (Win32 on Windows, pbcopy on macOS, wl-copy/xclip/xsel on Linux, tkinter as fallback), so it can be pasted after the dialog closes (revision2026c step RG11.8.21)
